SELECT
  table_name,
  column_name,
  data_type
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_bronze.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS`
WHERE table_name IN (
  'orders_external',
  'order_items_external',
  'review_external'
)

  COUNTIF(order_date IS NULL) AS dates_nulles,
  MIN(order_date) AS premiere_date,
  MAX(order_date) AS derniere_date

-- Q1 baseline : chiffre d'affaires mensuel sur 12 mois
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC(order_date, MONTH) AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(qty * price_at_purchase), 2) AS revenue
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.order_items`
WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-09-14', INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
  AND order_date <= DATE '2026-09-14'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

-- Q2 baseline : top 10 produits par quantité vendue
SELECT
  p_id,
  SUM(qty) AS units
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.order_items`
WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-09-14', INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
  AND order_date <= DATE '2026-09-14'
GROUP BY p_id
ORDER BY units DESC, p_id
LIMIT 10;

-- Q3 baseline : note moyenne par produit
SELECT
  pr.p_id,
  ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS n_reviews
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.review` AS r
JOIN `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.product_reviews` AS pr
  ON r.review_id = pr.review_id
GROUP BY pr.p_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, pr.p_id;

SELECT
  partition_id,
  total_rows,
  ROUND(total_logical_bytes / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS taille_mib
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS`
WHERE table_name = 'order_items_p'
ORDER BY partition_id

-- Q1 après partitionnement

WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-09-14', INTERVAL 12 MONTH)

-- Q3 après clustering
SELECT
  pr.p_id,
  ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS n_reviews
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.review` AS r
JOIN `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.product_reviews_c` AS pr

WITH product_days AS (
  SELECT
    p_id,
    order_date,
    COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.order_items_p`
  GROUP BY p_id, order_date
)
SELECT
  SUM(n_lines) AS lignes_commandes,
  COUNT(*) AS lignes_apres_agregation,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(n_lines), COUNT(*)),
    2
  ) AS collapse_ratio
FROM product_days;

-- Q2 sur la vue matérialisée quotidienne
SELECT
  p_id,
  SUM(units) AS units
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.mv_daily_demand`
WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-09-14', INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
  AND order_date <= DATE '2026-09-14'
GROUP BY p_id
ORDER BY units DESC, p_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH product_weeks AS (
  SELECT
    p_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK) AS week,
    COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.order_items_p`
  GROUP BY p_id, week
)
SELECT
  SUM(n_lines) AS lignes_commandes,
  COUNT(*) AS lignes_apres_agregation,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(n_lines), COUNT(*)),
    2
  ) AS collapse_ratio_semaine
FROM product_weeks;

-- Même calcul sur la vue hebdomadaire
SELECT
  p_id,
  SUM(units) AS units
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.mv_weekly_demand`
WHERE week >= DATE '2025-06-15'
  AND week < DATE '2025-09-14'
GROUP BY p_id
ORDER BY units DESC, p_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH depuis_table AS (
  SELECT
    p_id,
    SUM(qty) AS units
  FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.order_items_p`
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-06-15'
    AND order_date < DATE '2025-09-14'
  GROUP BY p_id
),
depuis_vue AS (
  SELECT
    p_id,
    SUM(units) AS units
  FROM `data-engineering-i1.g03_warehouse.mv_weekly_demand`
  WHERE week >= DATE '2025-06-15'
    AND week < DATE '2025-09-14'
  GROUP BY p_id
),
ecarts AS (
  (
    SELECT * FROM depuis_table
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT * FROM depuis_vue
  )
  UNION ALL
  (
    SELECT * FROM depuis_vue
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT * FROM depuis_table
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_ecarts
FROM ecarts;
